name: Central Coast Internet
summary: Central Coast NSW dialup + hosting + web design ISP (cci.net.au, ~1997); later pivoted to wireless broadband + home phone (Port Stephens); dead 2017 (CENTRAL COAST INTERNET PTY. LIMITED, ACN 073 222 536).

events.details: Dialup, hosting, web design; cci.net.au first captured 22 Oct 1997. CENTRAL COAST INTERNET PTY. LIMITED, ACN 073 222 536, NSW 2261.

Far outlived the earlier 'defunct c.2005' estimate: cci.net.au ran an actively-maintained site through 2018, having pivoted to wireless broadband + home phone ('© 2016 Central Coast Internet', ABN 93 073 222 536). ABN cancelled 30 Aug 2017; domain became a 301 redirect by 2019 (unrelated site from 2021).
